ui-command.name: Command

stories.name: Default
stories.snippet:
const Default = () => (
  <Command className="w-100 rounded-lg border">
    <CommandInput placeholder="Type a command..." />
    <CommandList>
      <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
      <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
        <CommandItem>
          Close conversation
          <CommandShortcut>⌘⇧C</CommandShortcut>
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem>
          Grant extra time
          <CommandShortcut>⌘E</CommandShortcut>
        </CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandSeparator />
      <CommandGroup heading="Navigate">
        <CommandItem>Go to Inbox</CommandItem>
        <CommandItem>Go to Reports</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </Command>
);

ui-dialog.name: Dialog

stories.name: Default
stories.snippet:
const Default = () => (
  <Dialog>
    <DialogTrigger render={<Button>Close conversation?</Button>} />
    <DialogContent>
      <DialogHeader>
        <DialogTitle>Close this conversation?</DialogTitle>
        <DialogDescription>
          You can still find it afterward under the Closed filter.
        </DialogDescription>
      </DialogHeader>
      <DialogFooter>
        <DialogClose render={<Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>} />
        <Button>Close conversation</Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
);
